The Solution

Book Now

Revolutionizing Pool Safety:

 SOSense introduces groundbreaking technology, setting a new industry standard for pool safety. Our unique product uses advanced underwater acoustic detection to identify unusual pool entries by children, dramatically reducing false alarms and empowering families with the confidence and security they deserve.

Cutting-Edge Technology

SOSense utilizes advanced sound sensors and intelligent algorithms to set new safety benchmarks in the pool industry. This technology not only detects general entries but is finely tuned to recognize specific patterns indicative of accidental entries, ensuring prompt alerts.

Proven
Effectiveness

Extensive testing across diverse pool environments and weather conditions has enabled SOSense to refine the accuracy and reliability of its detection system. Our commitment to rigorous testing ensures that our solution is both innovative and trustworthy.

Innovative Developments

In addition to our main product, we have developed and patented a novel early drowning detection system. This advanced product detects critical physiological sounds, such as those made by involuntary reflexes during the onset of drowning, enabling quicker response times.

Preventing Tragedies,
Saving Lives

For every parent, the thought of a child drowning in a swimming pool is a tragic and unimaginable nightmare. Globally, approximately 230,000 lives are lost to drowning each year, with 75% of victims being children under the age of four, primarily in private pools.

​

At SOSense, we’ve developed a state-of-the-art solution that utilizes groundbreaking acoustic detection technology. By providing precise, real-time alerts, our system ensures swift action to prevent drowning incidents, granting families peace of mind like never before.

Revolutionizing Pool Safety Standards:

SOSense introduces an industry-first technology that uses underwater acoustic detection to monitor pool activities.

This innovation significantly minimizes false alarms while ensuring unparalleled security for families.

Advanced Detection Technology:

Our solution leverages cutting-edge sound sensors and intelligent algorithms to detect irregular pool entries, specifically those indicative of accidental falls. This ensures timely alerts, empowering guardians to act quickly.

Proven Reliability:

With exhaustive testing across diverse pool setups and varying weather conditions, SOSense has honed its system’s performance to deliver consistent and trustworthy results.

A GAME CHANGING SOLUTION FOR POOL SAFETY

Saving lives with
an acoustic based Drowning Prevention technology

Our patented acoustic drowning detection technology sets new benchmarks in safety. Designed to recognize critical physiological sounds associated with kids' entry to pools and drowning reflexes, this system allows for immediate response, potentially saving lives when every second counts.
